about.body: The B58 is BMW's turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine, in production since 2015. It's one of the most widely-deployed engines in the current BMW range, fitted across every mainstream model line from the 2 Series up to the 7 Series, 8 Series and X7, plus the new XM and the Z4 roadster.

byModel.body: Across the 2 Series, the B58 has powered the M240i (F22/F23, 2016–2021) and continues in the current M240i xDrive (G42, 2021–present). The 3 Series uses it in the 340i (F30/F31, 2015–2019) and the current M340i xDrive (G20/G21, 2019–present). The 4 Series follows the same pattern with the 440i (F32/F33/F36, 2016–2020) and current M440i xDrive. The 5 Series carries it in the 540i across two generations, including the current PHEV-badged 550e xDrive. The 7 Series uses it in the 740i across G11/G12 and G70 generations. The 8 Series uses it in the 840i. Across the SUV range, the B58 appears in the X3 M40i and current M50 xDrive, the X4 M40i, and as the six-cylinder option throughout X5, X6 and X7, including their PHEV-badged 50e variants. It's also the entry-level combustion engine in the new XM 50e, and powers the current Z4 M40i through to 2026.

compatibility.body: A B58 from a 2 Series isn't a drop-in match for a B58 from an X7 — ancillaries, mounting, and hybrid-system integration all differ. Registration/VIN matching is required. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle. Same engine family ≠ same complete engine. The following vary by application: Engine code variant (petrol, MHEV, PHEV) Chassis-specific ancillaries Drivetrain configuration ECU/DME software Mounting Exhaust system Cooling system Hybrid integration Transmission mating Symptoms That Justify Inspection The following symptoms don't automatically mean the B58 requires a rebuild. Proper diagnosis comes first. Knocking or rattling noises Low oil pressure warning Excessive smoke Coolant loss Overheating Misfire or rough running Loss of compression Metal contamination in oil Engine seizure Warning lights Loss of power
